discovery.identification_rule: Use this plan only after the bounded Mesh adapter catalog has matched OpenClaw. Do not use this plan to explore whether the runtime might be OpenClaw.

agent_procedure.description: Confirm OpenClaw is installed and inspect its version without changing runtime state.
Download the exact package URL declared in PTM1 to a private temporary path.
Calculate SHA-256 and require an exact match to PTM1 before any installation.
Optionally use OpenClaw plugin validation against the downloaded artifact when supported.

Use OpenClaw's supported managed archive installer immediately after verification. The adapter is ownership-aware: if the stable local Mesh signaling port is already held by a verified prior Mesh adapter, reuse that listener during handoff instead of killing/rebinding it. Unknown ownership fails closed as port_conflict. Never restart the agent/runtime.
Verify the installed plugin through OpenClaw's plugin inspection surface.
Probe existing channels after installation/reload and ensure the owner's channel remains healthy.

Do not manually redeem/connect. The installed adapter consumes ~/.progretech-mesh/pending-enrollment.json and connects outbound to the decoded PTM1 mesh endpoint. Never substitute the local OpenClaw gateway. Check ~/.progretech-mesh/connection-status.json for at most 60 seconds; if not connected, stop with its exact blocker.

failure_behavior.unsupported_version: Report unsupported OpenClaw version to owner; do not install.
failure_behavior.missing_exec_permission: Report the minimum missing runtime permission through the existing chat.
failure_behavior.install_policy_block: Report the OpenClaw install-policy block; do not bypass it.
failure_behavior.capability_consent_block: Use the owner's existing agent/chat approval mechanism if available; otherwise report the required approval.
failure_behavior.runtime_busy: Do not defer merely because the enrollment chat is active. Continue only the declared hot-safe managed install; if OpenClaw explicitly blocks installation because of another active operation, report runtime_busy.
failure_behavior.channel_probe_failure: Report degraded channel state and stop further Mesh activation work.
failure_behavior.activation_handoff_missing: Do not search OpenClaw internals or alternate ports. Report activation_reload_required unless the declared connection-status file contains a more specific error.
failure_behavior.mesh_unreachable: Report the PTM1 mesh endpoint as unreachable; do not fall back to the local OpenClaw gateway or a guessed endpoint.
failure_behavior.local_signal_port_in_use: Authenticate the existing listener with the Mesh-local credential. If verified as ProgreTech Mesh, reuse it and continue activation; otherwise stop with port_conflict. Never kill the listener.

lifecycle.same_version: skip reinstall and reconnect using existing credential when valid
lifecycle.upgrade: verify new package, perform one ownership-aware hot-safe managed in-place install for the known runtime; reuse a verified existing Mesh local listener; never auto-restart; unknown port ownership fails closed
lifecycle.revoked: stop Mesh reconnect only; require new PTM1 enrollment
lifecycle.expired: stop Mesh reconnect only; require new PTM1 enrollment

activation_handoff.authoritative_mesh_target: Use the decoded PTM1 mesh field. Never substitute the local OpenClaw HTTP/gateway address (for example 127.0.0.1:18789).
activation_handoff.runtime_owner: The installed Mesh adapter consumes pending-enrollment.json and performs activation redemption/outbound Mesh connection.
activation_handoff.agent_must_not: Do not manually construct a gateway connection, search for alternate ports, reinstall the adapter, or probe framework internals when activation handoff does not complete.
activation_handoff.bounded_check: After install/runtime verification, check the declared connection-status file for up to 60 seconds. If it is absent or not connected, stop with activation_reload_required, activation_rejected, mesh_unreachable, or the exact status/error already reported.
activation_handoff.restart_rule: Do not restart automatically. A verified existing Mesh local signaling listener may remain active and be reused while the new adapter performs redemption/outbound connection. If the runtime explicitly requires reload/restart, stop with activation_reload_required. Unknown listener ownership is port_conflict.

existing_installation_fast_path.valid_credential: connect using stored credential and skip discovery/install/redeem
existing_installation_fast_path.adapter_present_credential_missing: only when installed adapter version matches the offered current version: redeem current activation directly and skip reinstall/runtime discovery; if installed version is older, perform one verified in-place upgrade first
